title: LLMObs price entry (v1alpha1)
description: One immutable, versioned pricing snapshot for a (provider, model) — the artifact cost derivation reads (ADR-0029; 06-usage-cost.md §4–§5, §7). Instance-global reference metadata: rates are data-driven (§7.4), the entry is never mutated (an edit creates a new version), and its id encodes provider/model/version so it IS the pricing_snapshot_ref (§5).
$comment: This is the STORED shape. On a create request (POST /v1alpha1/pricing) the readOnly fields (id, version, source, created_by, created_at) are server-assigned and ignored if sent; only provider, model, effective_from, and rates are required as input.

id.description: Server-assigned. Primary key and pricing_snapshot_ref id: "<provider-canonical>/<model-canonical>#<version>". Encodes everything a re-pricing backfill needs (D4).

provider.description: Canonical provider (D3, e.g. openai, anthropic, google). Aliases (vertex_ai/gemini/google_ai) collapse to one via the single provider-canonicalization table.

model.description: Canonical model key (D3). A provider-prefixed name (openai/gpt-4o) normalizes to the same key at load AND lookup (R6).

version.description: Server-assigned. Monotonic version per (provider, model). An edit appends the next version; prior versions are retained for re-derivability.

effective_from.description: Derivation applies this entry to a span when it is the newest version with effective_from <= span.start_time (time-correct pricing).

rates.description: Data-driven unit rates (§7.4/R4). Keyed by usage-detail key (input, output, cache_read, cache_write, reasoning, audio, image, and any future key). Presence of a key's rate — not a hardcoded provider/bucket list — is what makes a bucket specially priced.

per_token.description: Cost per token/unit for this bucket. float64 in Go/JSON; Decimal64(12) on the ClickHouse adapter (D7).

reduces.description: Which base count this bucket's tokens are subtracted from when computing the residual (§7.4/R3): base residual = base − Σ(bucket counts whose reduces == base). Absent = a standalone additive bucket (does not reduce a base). Makes the residual data-driven, never a hardcoded 'cache_read subtracts from input' branch.

tiers.description: Above-threshold (tiered) rates (§7.5/R7). Tokens of `key` above `threshold_tokens` bill at `per_token` instead of the base rate. The applied tier schedule is captured by the entry version (D4), so re-pricing is deterministic.

key.description: The usage-detail key this tier applies to (e.g. input).

threshold_tokens.description: Tokens above this count bill at the tier rate (e.g. 200000 for a >200k context tier).

per_token.description: Rate for tokens above the threshold.

source.description: Server-assigned. Provenance: 'default' seeded by the kernel; 'override' written by an operator. Informative only.

raw_provider.description: The verbatim provider string an operator supplied, preserved alongside the canonical provider (§0/D6). Never used for lookup.

created_by.description: Server-assigned. Actor that wrote this version (session identity), for audit. Null for seeded defaults.

created_at.description: Server-assigned. When this version row was inserted.
